scripts.install:all: cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && bun run build && cd ../frontend && bun run build
scripts.lint: cd backend && bun run lint && cd ../frontend && bun run lint
scripts.test: cd backend && bun run test && cd ../frontend && bun run test
